newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Caspian cuts recommended Argentina weighting.
newsitem.headline: Caspian cuts recommended Argentina weighting.

text.p: - Caspian Securities said it is reducing its recommended Latin American portfolio weighting of Argentina to five percent from eight percent because of price appreciation.

- "Since Dec 18, the Argentine market has appreciated by over eight percent which, based on our 1997 year-end forecast of 710 (on the Merval index), leaves a potential return of only seven percent for the remainder of the year. We feel that the market has gotten ahead of itself based on current valuation levels."
